name: Soul Rip
description: Tears at the soul of a unit within %cast_range% tiles, dealing %str_multiplier% damage for every point of strength this unit has over it. Cast on an ally instead to heal them by the same amount.

upgrade.summary: Also drags %str_steal% strength across with the soul.
details: Against an enemy, %str_steal% strength is torn away just before the damage lands - so the damage is reckoned from the wider gap.
On an ally, they are given %str_steal% strength just after the heal.
